description.en: Custom firmware mods for the UC Remote 3. Mod 1: configurable charging-screen screensaver with Matrix rain, Starfield, Minimal, Analog, and TV Static themes. Mod 3: compact battery indicator on every entity / activity detail page (v1.4.21 adds a sibling WiFi indicator with a Settings → UI toggle). Mod 4: WiFi UX bundle — live link diagnostics, always-visible signal indicator, reconnect button, WoWLAN toggle on UCR3. Mod 5: Active Session Keeper — resets the device's sleep countdown every 4.5 min via set_power_mode(NORMAL) pings while a media player is actively playing or recent media-control buttons are pressed. Mod 6: Phantom-Wake Suppressor — forces the device back to LOW_POWER if a wake event happens with no user input within a configurable grace window, eliminating WoWLAN-induced phantom-wake battery drain (v1.4.22 fixed the API call format that had silently broken Mod 5/6 since their respective releases; v1.4.23 added recent-input lookback to handle wake-press timing). Wake-replay HUD: post-wake reconnect banner — v1.4.21 made it more prominent (120 px height, font 32, brighter color, subtle pulse). v1.4.33 fixes a 70-second Settings → Power open delay caused by upstream Slider's tick Repeater over-instantiating thousands of invisible Rectangles when slider ranges are large (root cause v1.4.26 missed). v1.4.34: QML test coverage for BatteryStatusChip / WifiStatusChip / ReconnectingHUD overlays — closes the largest contiguous block of zero-coverage custom UI per the audit roadmap (B5). v1.4.35: HUD test fix — `SequentialAnimation on opacity` and `RotationAnimation on rotation` register as property value sources, not children/resources, so they're unreachable via findByObjectName traversal. Replaced with binding-chain test on `hud.active`. Also bundles `images.qrc` into test resources (silences spurious loader_small.png warning).
